很容易分析并逆向出解密脚本

```python
for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i){
DWORD bak = ans[i];
ans[i] = (ans[i] - key) & 0xFFFFFFFF;
key ^= bak;
}
BYTE *p = (BYTE *)ans;
for(int i=0;i<0x20;++i)
printf("%c", *(p+i));
```
